segments.en: An interactive explainer that makes CI/CD click: feel the pain, hire a robot, extend the pipeline, read the file.
segments.zh: 一個讓 CI/CD 真正搞懂的互動解說：先感受痛苦、請一個機器人、延長流水線，最後讀懂設定檔。

segments.en: You've heard “CI/CD” a hundred times. Let's make it click.
segments.zh: 「CI/CD」你聽過一百遍了。這次讓它真正搞懂。

segments.en: Definitions don't stick. Pain does. In about 5 minutes you'll run a team the old way, watch it fall apart, then fix it one robot at a time.
segments.zh: 定義記不住，痛才記得住。大約 5 分鐘，你會用老方法帶一個團隊、看它崩潰，然後一次請一個機器人把它修好。

segments.en: Act 0Ship the old way and feel why it hurts
segments.zh: 第 0 幕用老方法出貨，感受為什麼痛

segments.en: Act 1 · CIHire a robot that checks every change
segments.zh: 第 1 幕 · CI請一個機器人檢查每一次變更

segments.en: Act 2 · CDLet the robot pack and ship it too
segments.zh: 第 2 幕 · CD讓機器人也負責打包和出貨

segments.en: Act 3Read the real file. It's shorter than you think.
segments.zh: 第 3 幕讀真正的設定檔。比你想的短。
第 0 幕 · 沒有 CI/CD 的日子

segments.en: The old way: everyone codes alone, then merges at the end
segments.zh: 老方法：每個人各自寫程式，最後才合併

segments.en: Four devs each work on their own branch for three weeks. main stays untouched until merge day. Nobody runs the full test suite until then because it's slow and manual.
segments.zh: 四位開發者各自在自己的分支上工作三週。main 一直沒人動，直到合併日。在那之前沒有人跑完整的測試，因為又慢又要手動。

segments.en: 🐞 Tests finally run: checkout total is wrong. Introduced by Ben… three weeks ago. Ben: “I honestly don't remember writing that.”
segments.zh: 🐞 測試終於跑了：結帳總金額算錯。是 Ben……三週前寫的。Ben：「我真的不記得我寫過那段。」

segments.en: Finally fixed. Now deploy it, by hand, from the wiki checklist.
segments.zh: 終於修好了。現在照著 wiki 上的清單，手動部署。

segments.en: Notice the pattern: every problem came from two things. Changes were checked late (merge day), and shipping was done by hand (the checklist). CI fixes the first. CD fixes the second.
segments.zh: 注意這個模式：每個問題都來自兩件事。變更太晚才檢查（合併日），出貨靠人工（那張清單）。CI 解決第一件，CD 解決第二件。
請一個機器人 → 第 1 幕
第 1 幕 · 持續整合

segments.en: CI: merge small changes often, and a robot checks every one
segments.zh: CI：經常合併小變更，機器人檢查每一次

segments.en: Same team, new rule: push small changes to main several times a day. Every push wakes up a robot (a server somewhere) that merges it, builds it, and runs the tests within minutes. Try both buttons.
segments.zh: 同一個團隊，新規則：一天好幾次把小變更推上 main。每次推送都會叫醒一個機器人（某處的一台伺服器），在幾分鐘內幫你合併、建置、跑測試。兩個按鈕都試試看。

segments.en: Push a change with a bug
segments.zh: 推送一個有 bug 的變更
修好它（5 分鐘）並重新推送

segments.en: Each green push adds a square to main. A red one is stopped before it lands.
segments.zh: 每次綠燈的推送都會在 main 上加一個方塊。紅燈的會在進去之前被擋下來。
為什麼要「經常」？拖拉看看。

segments.en: Team merges into main every: 1 day
segments.zh: 團隊合併進 main 的頻率：每 1 天

segments.en: Illustrative numbers, but the shape is real: the longer you wait to merge, the bigger and riskier each merge gets.
segments.zh: 示意數字，但趨勢是真的：越久才合併，每次合併就越大、越危險。

segments.en: Merge small changes into main often, and a robot builds and tests each one so problems show up in minutes, not on merge day.
segments.zh: 經常把小變更合併進 main，由機器人建置並測試每一次，讓問題在幾分鐘內浮現，而不是等到合併日。

segments.en: The “I” means integration: combining everyone's code. It's “continuous” because it happens all the time instead of once at the end.
segments.zh: 「I」指的是整合（integration）：把所有人的程式碼結合起來。說它「持續」，是因為它隨時都在發生，而不是最後才做一次。
第 2 幕 · 持續交付 / 持續部署
CD：同一個機器人，更長的流水線

segments.en: CI stopped at “tests pass.” CD keeps going: the robot packages the app, puts it on a staging server (a private copy of the real site), and then it goes to production, the site real users see. The one question left: does a human press a button first?
segments.zh: CI 停在「測試通過」。CD 會繼續往下：機器人把 App 打包，放到 staging 伺服器（真實網站的私人副本），然後送上 production，也就是真正使用者看到的網站。剩下唯一的問題：要不要先由人按一個按鈕？

segments.en: Every passing change is ready to ship. A person decides when.
segments.zh: 每個通過的變更都隨時可以出貨，由人決定什麼時候。

segments.en: Push a few changes with the switch on, then turn it off and push again.
segments.zh: 開關打開時推送幾次變更，然後關掉開關，再推送。

segments.en: Continuous Delivery: every passing change is ready to ship, and a human presses the button. Continuous Deployment: there's no button, and passing changes go straight to users.
segments.zh: 持續交付（Delivery）：每個通過的變更都隨時可以出貨，由人按下按鈕。持續部署（Deployment）：沒有按鈕，通過的變更直接送到使用者面前。

segments.en: Both need CI underneath. CD without good tests just ships bugs faster.
segments.zh: 兩者底下都需要 CI。沒有好的測試，CD 只是更快地把 bug 送出去。
第 3 幕 · 真正的設定檔

segments.en: The robot reads a short to-do list
segments.zh: 機器人讀的是一張短短的待辦清單

segments.en: This is a real GitHub Actions file for everything you just watched. It lives in the repo at .github/workflows/ship.yml. Hover or tap a line to see which stage it is.
segments.zh: 這是一個真實的 GitHub Actions 檔案，涵蓋你剛剛看到的一切。它放在 repo 的 .github/workflows/ship.yml。把滑鼠移到某一行上，或點一下，看看它是哪個階段。

segments.en: Each highlighted line maps to one stage of the pipeline above.
segments.zh: 每一行反白後，都會對應到上面流水線的一個階段。

segments.en: The big reveal: a pipeline is just a trigger (“when someone pushes”) + a list of commands (the same ones you'd type yourself) + a borrowed computer to run them on. GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins and CircleCI are all the same idea, just different robots reading different file formats.
segments.zh: 真相大白：流水線不過就是一個觸發條件（「有人推送時」）＋一串指令（就是你自己會打的那些）＋一台借來的電腦來執行它們。GitHub Actions、GitLab CI、Jenkins、CircleCI 都是同一個概念，只是不同的機器人，讀不同格式的檔案。
重點整理 · 帶走這些

segments.en: The whole thing on one screen
segments.zh: 整件事濃縮在一個畫面

segments.en: Merge small changes often. A robot builds and tests every one. Bugs show up in minutes, while they're still cheap to fix.
segments.zh: 經常合併小變更。機器人建置並測試每一次。Bug 在幾分鐘內浮現，那時修起來還很便宜。

segments.en: The robot also packages and stages every passing change, so it's always ready to ship. A human picks when.
segments.zh: 機器人還會打包並部署每一個通過的變更到 staging，所以隨時可以出貨。由人決定什麼時候。

segments.en: Same pipeline, no button. Every change that passes goes straight to users.
segments.zh: 同樣的流水線，沒有按鈕。每個通過的變更都直接送到使用者面前。

segments.en: A problem found minutes after you write it takes minutes to fix. Found three weeks later, it takes days. CI/CD makes “minutes later” the default.
segments.zh: 寫完幾分鐘就發現的問題，幾分鐘就能修好。三週後才發現，就要花好幾天。CI/CD 讓「幾分鐘後」變成預設。

segments.en: P.S. Next time you see a ✅ or ❌ next to a commit on GitHub, that's the robot from Act 1 reporting back. A “Deploy” job after it is Act 2.
segments.zh: 附註：下次你在 GitHub 的提交旁邊看到 ✅ 或 ❌，那就是第 1 幕的機器人在回報。後面接著的「Deploy」工作就是第 2 幕。

segments.en: ' - run: npm ci && npm run build'

segments.zh: ' environment: production # 需要核准'

segments.en: 'Run this whenever someone pushes to main. This is the “continuous” part: nobody starts the robot, the push does.'
segments.zh: '每當有人推送到 main 就執行。這就是「持續」的部分：不是人去啟動機器人，是推送啟動的。'

segments.en: 'Borrow a fresh Linux machine from GitHub for a few minutes. That machine is the robot. It starts clean every time, so “works on my machine” can\'t sneak in.'
segments.zh: '向 GitHub 借一台全新的 Linux 機器用幾分鐘。那台機器就是機器人。它每次都從乾淨的狀態開始，所以「在我電腦上可以跑」混不進來。'

segments.en: 'Download the latest code, including the change that was just merged. This is the integration in CI.'
segments.zh: '下載最新的程式碼，包括剛合併的變更。這就是 CI 裡的整合。'

segments.en: 'The exact commands you\'d type yourself. If the code doesn\'t even compile, stop here.'
segments.zh: '就是你自己會打的那些指令。如果程式碼連編譯都過不了，就停在這裡。'

segments.en: 'Run every automated test. This one line is why CI is useful. No tests means the robot has nothing to check.'
segments.zh: '跑每一個自動化測試。CI 有用全靠這一行。沒有測試，機器人就沒有東西可以檢查。'

segments.en: 'Save the built app as a file (an “artifact”). Every later stage ships this exact file, not a rebuild.'
segments.zh: '把建置好的 App 存成一個檔案（「artifact」）。之後的每個階段出貨的都是這個檔案，而不是重新建置。'

segments.en: 'Only start if the previous job passed. One red stage stops everything after it. That\'s what makes it a pipeline.'
segments.zh: '只有前一個工作通過才會開始。只要一個階段亮紅燈，後面的全部停止。這就是它被稱為流水線的原因。'

segments.en: 'Put it on a private copy of the real site. From here on it\'s CD: the change is ready to ship.'
segments.zh: '放到真實網站的私人副本上。從這裡開始就是 CD：變更已經隨時可以出貨。'

segments.en: 'In GitHub settings, the production environment can require a reviewer. Keep this line and you have Continuous Delivery. Delete it and you have Continuous Deployment. One line is the whole difference.'
segments.zh: '在 GitHub 設定中，production 環境可以要求審核者。保留這一行，就是持續交付；刪掉它，就是持續部署。整個差別就在這一行。'

segments.en: 'Ship to real users. The robot runs the same script every time, so there\'s no wiki checklist and no forgotten config file.'
segments.zh: '送到真實使用者面前。機器人每次都跑同一個腳本，所以沒有 wiki 清單，也不會忘記設定檔。'

segments.en: 'CI/CD is a tool, like Jenkins or GitHub Actions.'
segments.zh: 'CI/CD 是一種工具，就像 Jenkins 或 GitHub Actions。'

segments.en: 'It\'s a practice: merge often, check automatically, ship automatically. Jenkins and GitHub Actions are just robots that carry it out.'
segments.zh: '它是一種做法：經常合併、自動檢查、自動出貨。Jenkins 和 GitHub Actions 只是執行它的機器人。'

segments.en: 'Without automated tests, CI can\'t do much.'
segments.zh: '沒有自動化測試，CI 能做的事很有限。'

segments.en: 'The robot can only check what you\'ve written checks for. With no tests, “green” only means it compiled.'
segments.zh: '機器人只能檢查你寫了檢查的東西。沒有測試，「綠燈」只代表它編譯過了。'

segments.en: 'Continuous Delivery means every commit goes to production automatically.'
segments.zh: '持續交付的意思是每個提交都自動送上正式環境。'

segments.en: 'That\'s Deployment. Delivery means every commit could go out, and a human presses the button.'
segments.zh: '那是部署（Deployment）。交付（Delivery）的意思是每個提交都可以出去，由人按下按鈕。'

segments.en: 'The “integration” in CI means merging everyone\'s code into main often, ideally at least daily.'
segments.zh: 'CI 裡的「整合」，是指經常把所有人的程式碼合併進 main，最好至少每天一次。'

segments.en: 'Long-lived branches that merge once a month aren\'t CI, even if a robot runs tests on them.'
segments.zh: '一個月才合併一次的長壽分支不算 CI，即使有機器人在上面跑測試。'

segments.en: 'CD only makes sense for big companies.'
'A solo project on GitHub Pages or Vercel is usually continuously deployed: push to main and it\'s live a minute later, and setting that up costs nothing.'
segments.zh: '放在 GitHub Pages 或 Vercel 上的個人專案，通常就是持續部署：推送到 main，一分鐘後就上線了，而且設定起來不用花一毛錢。'
